correctness.rationale: TARGET route: independent replay of inputs/artifacts/verify.py gives CHECKS=237 VERIFY_OK (stdlib Fractions only). Lemma 1 closed form q*P_n=(q-1)^2*S_n with S_n=(q-1)^n*f+(-1)^n*g, f=q^2-3q+3, g=2q-3 was verified: brute-force Zaslavsky backtracking for n<=4, q in {1,3,5,7} matches formula (16 checks); exact identities (q-1)f-g=q(q-2)^2, S_n(0)=0, monic deg n+3, (q-1)^2|P_n, odd-n split, transfer recurrences X_{k+1}=(q-2)X_k+(q-1)X_{k-1} for A_k,B_k and P recomposition all hold exactly. Manual audit confirms transfer-matrix derivation M=J-I, M^k formula, A_k/B_k closed forms, and admissible-pair count q(q-1)=(q-1)+(q-1)^2 are correct; agreement on all odd q lifts to polynomial identity. Lemma 2 dominance is a complete proof for all n: even n both summands >0 for q>2 since f=(q-1)(q-2)+1>0, g=2(q-2)+1>0; odd n uses m=(q-1)^n>=(q-1) and key identity to get S_n>=(q-1)f-g=q(q-2)^2>0 on q>2. Hence no zero on (2,infinity), a fortiori [3,infinity) with a=3<=4; S_n(2)=1+(-1)^n gives exact root P_n(2)=0 for all odd n, so barrier 2 is sharp. Sturm V(3)-V(inf)=0 for n<=6 and certified census n<=12 corroborate but are not needed beyond the analytic proof. Even-n all-n monotonicity via S_n'=(q-1)^{n-1}(nf+(q-1)(2q-3))+2(-1)^n with SoS identities f-3/4=(q-3/2)^2 and (q-1)(2q-3)+1/8=2(q-5/4)^2 is correct in conclusion S_n'>0 and unique root in (1,2); only scope overstatement is the remark claiming S_n'>=27/8 on [1,infinity) — the 27/8 bound holds on [2,infinity) while S_n'>=2 holds on [1,infinity), still strictly positive, so the theorem is unaffected. Lemma 3 path matching polynomials k<=8 real-rooted with boxes <2 and consecutive interlacing replayed exactly; it is auxiliary to the main implication and correctly not claimed for P_n themselves. Head polynomials P1=(q-1)^2(q-2)^2, P2, P3 and fallback F1-F3 counts 2,2,3 with disjoint Sturm-1 intervals replay exactly.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison to nearest priors, not timestamp: Beck et al. 1311.1760 lists only fixed signed Petersen graphs and all signed complete graphs to 5 vertices (no F_n subdivision family, no infinite-family formula, no real interval, no root isolation); Jackson-Procacci-Sokal 0810.4703 proves generic complex large-|q| discs for multivariate Tutte/Potts via polymer gas, implying some non-sharp disc for any fixed graph but no sharp uniform real half-line [a,infinity) and no extremal witness for F_n; Sehrawat-Bhattacharjya 2206.08580 gives formulas for unrelated m-cycle book graphs B(m,n) (n copies of C_m on common edge), different object/construction; Greaves et al. 2407.00883 gives joins of all-positive/all-negative complete graphs, dominating-vertex bivariate formulae and threshold families, no subdivision family or uniform real interval; Goregaokar 2506.00941 gives coefficient/hyperplane interpretations, no family root locus. arXiv API signed+chromatic+subdivision query returns only generic/ unrelated hits, no F_n polynomial or root table. Closed form, optimal barrier 2, and attained odd-n root 2 are not mechanically implied by generic discs or fixed-graph tables; they require the computed deletion-contraction/transfer induction.

value.rationale: TARGET audit against admitted target (no preset-value presumption applied beyond normal standard). Result decides the admitted target_claim in full and stronger: explicit a=3<=4 uniform half-line for all n, sharpened to optimal barrier 2 with attained extremal roots at every odd n, plus exact closed form and reusable transfer recurrences. Family F_n is the canonical one-parameter positive-path deformation of unbalanced signed K4 (head n=1,2,3 fixes base pattern, first step, stability check) and half-line above unsigned-K4 root 3 is the natural probe; this is the recognized Zaslavsky/Sokal-Jackson/matroid-characteristic frontier where each decided interval or extremal root is the standard progress unit, with stated Potts/Ising, reliability and Tutte-benchmark reuse. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration: exact invariant of motivated natural objects, value not known or mechanically implied, future researcher can retrieve precise fact and reuse trees as induction base. Incomplete-census concerns do not apply since headline infinite-family claim is proved; head table is corroborating data.
